query:
WITH raw_input AS (
    SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
        $3::TEXT[], $4::TEXT[], $5::TEXT[], $6::TEXT[], $7::BOOLEAN[],
        $8::BIGINT[], $9::BIGINT[], $10::SMALLINT[], $11::TEXT[]
    ) AS value(book_id, dir_id, file_name, content_hash, present, changed_at, client_seq, version_rank, event_id)
),
input AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (dir_id, file_name) *
    FROM raw_input
    ORDER BY dir_id, file_name, changed_at DESC, version_rank DESC, client_seq DESC, event_id COLLATE "C" DESC
),
old_state AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT input.dir_id, input.file_name,
           CASE WHEN placement.present THEN placement.content_hash END AS content_hash
    FROM input
    LEFT JOIN sync_book_placement_state AS placement
      ON placement.library_id=$1
     AND placement.dir_id=input.dir_id
     AND placement.file_name=input.file_name
),
stored AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_book_placement_state(
        library_id, book_id, dir_id, file_name, content_hash, present,
        changed_at, client_id, client_seq, version_rank, event_id
    )
    SELECT $1, book_id, dir_id, file_name, NULLIF(content_hash, ''), present,
           changed_at, $2, client_seq, version_rank, event_id
    FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (library_id, dir_id, file_name) DO UPDATE SET
        book_id=EXCLUDED.book_id, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash, present=EXCLUDED.present,
        changed_at=EXCLUDED.changed_at, client_id=EXCLUDED.client_id,
        client_seq=EXCLUDED.client_seq, version_rank=EXCLUDED.version_rank,
        event_id=EXCLUDED.event_id, server_seq=DEFAULT
    WHERE (EXCLUDED.present OR sync_book_placement_state.book_id=EXCLUDED.book_id)
    RETURNING dir_id, file_name,
              CASE WHEN present THEN content_hash END AS content_hash
)
SELECT old_state.content_hash AS previous_hash,
       stored.content_hash AS current_hash
FROM stored
JOIN old_state USING(dir_id, file_name)
WHERE old_state.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM stored.content_hash;
